description:
RULED by the USER s488 (2026-09-17) on Fable's recommendation (open since s486): the skip registry (`cl/skip-registry.lisp`, 103 patterns / 24 files, relabels ~198 failing rows per sweep as `ok N # skip [registry] reason`) and the `NS:` cause column of `baselines/fail-baseline.tsv` (s486a, `PCLCauses::cause_class`) both say "not supported" -- two mechanisms own one fact.  The registry is RETIRED; the cause column stays.  Scheduled AFTER the next tag because the headline fail count moves 649 -> ~830 (the registry rows join the fail count; the PASS count does not move) and the README/STATUS figures are refreshed at tag time (s488 ruling 3).  Blocked by the TAG (an event, not a task).

RECIPE (mechanical -- every registry reason already cites a not-supported.md section):
1. One sweep on a clean tree; from `.faillog` take every row the registry relabelled (the `[registry]` marker; 198 at s486b).  Each becomes a `fail-baseline.tsv` row whose cause is `NS: <section>` copied from the registry entry's reason -- ROW BY ROW, never a bless; `tools/cause-census.pl --hygiene` clean.
2. Delete `cl/skip-registry.lisp` and its loader in `cl/pcl-test.lisp` (the `[registry]` marker + the stale detector).  The s486b instruments become dead: the two `_status.tsv` columns `registry_skips`/`registry_stale`, the `(N by the registry)` TOTAL suffix + `REGISTRY-STALE:` line in `tools/sweep-perl-tests.pl`, the `REGISTRY` line in `tools/sweep-diff.pl`, the registry field in `tools/cause-census.pl` (+ its `tools/t/cause-census.t` rows), the `registry` reads in `tools/run-perl-suite.pl` and `tools/dup-census.pl` -- remove them in the same batch, or keep them reading zero if removal costs more than it saves; the batch decides and SAYS WHY.
3. The stale detector's replacement is the sweep's FIXED bucket: a migrated row that starts passing shows as FIXED in sweep-diff and leaves the baseline by edit (the standing rule).  No new mechanism.
4. Docs: CLAUDE.md principle 5 ("declarative skip-registry") rewritten to the cause column; `docs/test-skip-registry.md` -> `docs/history/`; `docs/test-debugging-runbook.md`'s REGISTER branch -> "add the row with an `NS:` cause"; STATUS.md/README at the tag refresh; a DECIDED line.
5. BAR: sweep TOTAL passing UNCHANGED; `sweep-diff` 0 new / 0 fixed / 0 LOST after the baseline edit; cause-census NS count up by EXACTLY the migrated rows; the gate green (grep Pl/t + tools/t for `skip-registry`/`registry` rows first and rewrite or delete them with the mechanism); NO companion leg needed (the companion never loads the registry, s486b).

Pointers: DECIDED `## s486b` (the two-mechanisms ruling, the counting), `## s486` (the measurement: ~180-198 relabelled rows OUTSIDE the 649; 19 stale entries had accumulated -- the failure mode the retirement removes), `## s488` (this ruling).
subject: Retire the skip registry in favour of the `NS:` cause column -- AFTER the next tag (USER ruling s488, 2026-09-17): one mechanism owns "fails by deliberate non-support"; headline 649 -> ~830 fails, pass count unchanged
